meta.name: frame-flowchart-sticky
meta.description: SVG 曲线连接 + 便利贴节点 + 光标交互, 像白板 brainstorm

copy.tagline: 在白板上绘制曲线连接和便利贴节点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在白板风格中快速绘制连接图和便签
copy.tagline_en: Draw curved connections and sticky notes on a whiteboard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly draw connection diagrams and sticky notes in a whiteboard style

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把你的流程或系统画成一张白板风格的便利贴流程图，包含手写体节点、SVG 曲线连接和光标交互。
howto.when: 当你描述一个流程、工作流或系统架构，并希望以白板便利贴风格展示时触发。

say.text: 帮我画一个用户注册流程的便利贴流程图。
say.note: Claude 会生成 5-12 个节点的白板风格流程图。

say.text: 用便利贴风格展示这个系统架构。
say.note: Claude 会以节点和连接线呈现架构。

say.text: 把这个 onboarding 流程做成便利贴图。
say.note: Claude 会生成带手写体和曲线连接的流程图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will draw your process or system as a whiteboard-style sticky note flowchart, with handwritten fonts, SVG curved connections, and cursor interaction.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you describe a process, workflow, or system architecture and want it displayed in a whiteboard sticky note style.

say_en.text: Draw a sticky note flowchart for user registration.
say_en.note: Claude generates a 5-12 node whiteboard-style flowchart.

say_en.text: Show this system architecture as sticky notes.
say_en.note: Claude presents architecture with nodes and connections.

say_en.text: Make this onboarding flow into a sticky note diagram.
say_en.note: Claude creates a flowchart with handwritten fonts and curved lines.
